body:
Hello, thank you for contributing to the Godot engine!

As a performance-oriented PR, it's important to address code that is likely to have a practical impact on games. This function is called fairly often, so this may qualify — however, it is important to show a meaningful improvement over the code currently in use.
Practically, that means you should run benchmarks on this function - one before, and one after your change. If it performs substantially better with your change, it should be a good motivation to merge it.

That aside, I suspect this change will not have any impact. `p_cstr` is a `Span`, whose functions called here are trivial, and are guaranteed to be inlined. An optimizing compiler should be able to reduce RAM fetches, and assign registers to values appropriately to optimize the code for us.
